name: Dettivo
author: Gordon Mickel
description: Dictation state in the bar, the Dettivo panel, and the recording pill hosted by the shell.

barWidget.description: Idle, recording, transcribing and meeting state from the Dettivo daemon; click for the panel.

schema.label: Bar glyph
schema.description: The six-bar mark or a single dot. Written to [omarchy] glyph in config.toml.

schema.label: Level meter
schema.description: The bars follow the microphone level while recording. Written to [omarchy] level_meter.

schema.label: Recording pill
schema.description: panel: this plugin hosts the pill. service: dettivo-osd.service keeps it. off: no pill. Written to [omarchy] osd.
